Question
========
What is data plagiarism?

Answerlist
----------
* using data collected by another author or working group
* using data without attribution
* concealing some features of the dataset used
* getting anauthorized access to data 


Solution
========
Data plagiarism is using data without attribution.

Answerlist
----------
* False
* True
* False
* False
